evidence.assertion: The NG protocol accepts complete SDP offer/answer bodies and returns rewritten SDP.
The NG protocol can delete a branch/call and query current call facts.

evidence.locator: start recording; stop recording; pause recording
evidence.assertion: Recording can be started, stopped, paused and resumed per call.

evidence.locator: start forwarding and stop forwarding Messages
evidence.assertion: Media forwarding/forking can be controlled independently from call deletion.
Packet streams maintain separate RTP/RTCP sinks and forwarding handlers.
The source declares in-kernel packet forwarding for low latency and CPU.
The daemon automatically falls back to userspace when the kernel module is unavailable.
ICE-aware and ICE-unaware endpoints can be bridged with relay and ICE-lite modes.
SDES SRTP and RTP/SRTP bridging are implemented.
DTLS-SRTP and supported SRTP crypto suites are implemented.
Codec transcoding and repacketization are part of the source tree.
T.38 to PCM/G.711 transcoding is declared.
Media forking and N-to-N publish/subscribe forwarding are implemented.
Direct PCAP recording runs in userspace and prevents in-kernel forwarding for recorded calls.

constraints.required_action: V2 must use a separately measured proc/recording-daemon or media-fork design; PCAP results cannot inherit V1 kernel capacity.

evidence.assertion: Only a bounded number of packets are retained per stream and late consumers lose packets.

constraints.required_action: Expose recording consumer lag/drop metrics and stop new mandatory-recording admission before accepted evidence is lost.

evidence.assertion: GNU/Linux is the supported runtime platform.

constraints.required_action: Keep rtpengine in Linux Cell media pools; Windows endpoints remain clients only.

evidence.assertion: The high-performance kernel path is delivered as a DKMS/nftables module coupled to the host kernel.

constraints.required_action: Pin and validate the target kernel/nftables matrix; userspace fallback has a distinct capacity profile.
